instruction_bn: clue ছাড়া প্রসঙ্গ বুঝে শূন্যস্থানে উপযুক্ত শব্দ বসাও (Board: cloze test without clues, 1×10)।

items.q: Patriotism is a noble virtue. Every citizen should love ___ country.
Discipline is essential ___ every walk of life.
items.rule_bn: 'in every walk of life' একটি নির্দিষ্ট প্রকাশ।

items.q: A good citizen obeys the law and pays taxes ___ time.
Newspapers keep us ___ of what is happening around us.
The main purpose ___ education is to build good character.
We should not look ___ upon the poor.
He is not only wise ___ also kind.
